note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English; figures and measurements after Chhotani 1975; three sections, alate, soldier and pseudoworker, with no worker. OCR problem: one digit of the alate body length 'without wings 4.(X)-4.70' is defective and is not recorded; the remaining measurements are transcribed as they stand. The synonym Glyptotermes nigrifrons is not given separately.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown; labrum and legs brown; antennae slightly darker; thorax and abdomen slightly paler than the head; sternites paler than tergites, the middle of the first 4 sternites pale yellow. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length with wings 6.40—6.70 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, head length to mandible base 0.87—0.90 mm, head width 0.85—0.93 mm; Y suture present. Compound eyes oval (long diameter 0.25 mm), black, their distance from the lower margin of the head less than their short diameter. Ocelli small, oval (length 0.07 mm, width 0.05 mm), semi-transparent, touching the compound eyes, vertical in lateral view. Antennae 11—12-segmented; segment 2 about half of segment 1, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2. Clypeus subtrapezoidal, the boundary between ante- and postclypeus not evident; anteclypeus hairless, weakly projecting forwards in the middle; postclypeus with a few short hairs near the posterior margin. Labrum wider than long (length 0.23 mm, width 0.33 mm), with a few hairs near the anterior margin and on the disc. Mandibles of the Glyptotermes type. Pronotum subrectangular, slightly narrower than the head width including the eyes (length 0.50—0.57 mm, width 0.80—0.83 mm); anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short, pilose; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; arolium present. Wings pale brown; forewing length 4.9—5.0 mm, hindwing length 4.6—4.75 mm; with minute wart-like spots; all veins except the cubitus thick and sclerotised. The radius joins the costa at about the proximal 1/6 of the wing membrane in the forewing and the proximal 1/4 in the hindwing. Abdomen elongate-oval, sparsely pilose.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule red-yellow, reddish brown anteriorly and slightly paler posteriorly; antennae yellow to pale brown; labrum pale brown; thorax and abdomen yellow to pale reddish yellow, pronotum slightly darker; last abdominal tergite weakly to strongly sclerotised compared with the preceding ones. Head and body sparsely pilose. Body length 4.20—6.00 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, head length to mandible base 1.33—1.70 mm, head width 1.00—1.20 mm; frons inclined forwards at about 45°, bilobed, concave in the middle; Y suture distinct; anterior lateral angles projecting sharply forwards. Compound eyes oval, unpigmented. Ocelli minute, dot-like, one at the end of each lateral arm of the Y suture. Antennae 9—11-segmented; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 variable, either short, or about as long as segment 2, or longer, sometimes divided into two segments. Clypeus subtrapezoidal; anteclypeus pale brown, hairless, shorter than or equal to the postclypeus; postclypeus as dark as the frons and pilose, separated from the frons by a fine groove. Labrum broadly tongue-shaped (length 0.13—0.23 mm, width 0.27—0.30 mm); pilose near the apex and on the disc. Mandibles short, 0.63—0.77 mm long, shorter than half the head length without the mandibles; outer margin of the base with a weak to distinct swelling. Left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first and second close together, the third larger and separated from them by a curved, notched margin; right mandible with 2 small marginal teeth in the middle third. Postmentum long, club-shaped; waist long, narrowest behind the middle; length 0.83—1.17 mm, maximum width 0.35—0.44 mm, waist width 0.19—0.27 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, length 0.5—0.6 mm, width 0.87—1.05 mm, narrower than the head; anterior margin distinctly incurved; posterior margin rounded or sometimes weakly incurved in the middle. Mesonotum narrower than, metanotum wider than the pronotum, the posterior margin of both slightly emarginate. Legs short, pilose; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3. Abdomen elongate-oval; the 10th tergite slightly to strongly sclerotised; cerci short, 2-segmented; styli single-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule pale yellow to pale reddish yellow; antennae, labrum and legs paler; body milky white, pronotum slightly sclerotised. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 4.90—6.20 mm. Head capsule subcircular, head length to mandible base 0.90—1.07 mm, head width 0.93—1.10 mm. Compound eyes unpigmented, sometimes indiscernible. Antennae 10—11-segmented; segment 3 equal to or shorter than segment 2. Clypeus, labrum and mandibles as in the alate. Pronotum subrectangular, length 0.53—0.70 mm, width 0.83—1.00 mm, narrower than the head; anterior margin incurved; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
